title: THE SCREEN CLEAR SPARES EVERYTHING SPECIAL
why: From the cloud review of the party builds, and his own words about the screen clear ("this is like a nuke in zombies? keep it i guess but it shouldn't hurt pillagers"). The pulse already spared bosses, elites and pillagers, but a golden machine died to it (and dropped its hoard with no GOLD HUNTER), so did the convoy carrier, which solved the whole convoy event in one press, and so did the bounty hunter, the machines the Overseer summons and the stronghold garrisons. Now the pulse kills only ordinary machines. A second problem was in a linked window: player 2's pulse sent each machine to the host as a 9999-damage round, which the host throws away over 1500, so nothing died; and had it, each machine would have counted as his kill with score, streak, medals and air strike charge. His window now sends a pulse word that the host applies and credits to nobody, as the solo pulse does, and he is paid the same flat medal as solo.
now: The screen clear leaves golden, carrier, bounty, summoned and stronghold machines alone and credits nobody in co-op.
